headline: Splatterina night worker
title: Splatterina | Handiwork Six Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for a top crafter in Palworld one point zero? Splatterina is a Dark Pal that works Handiwork level six and Medicine Production level five, with Lumbering level three and Transporting level two. In the wild it only appears at night, and its alpha is a level sixty five boss near the Oculus Gate. Will you hunt Splatterina after dark? Comment below!
description: Splatterina in Palworld 1.0 is a Dark Pal with Handiwork level six and Medicine Production level five, found at night.
joke: Splatterina says crafting is her cutting edge hobby.
